title: Are parents given training or strategies to use at home during their child's Speech Therapy?
metaTitle: Parent Training for At-Home Speech Therapy Techniques | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms Network equips parents with effective strategies and activities to support their child's Speech Therapy progress at home.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we value and encourage parental involvement. We understand the importance of consistency and reinforcement in a familiar environment. Our Speech Therapists equip parents with practical strategies and at-home activities aligned with the therapy goals. This guides parents in becoming proactive partners in their child's therapeutic journey, enabling the child to put into practice the skills learned during therapy sessions at home.
